title: JBank announces International Version release rules for long-term staking
description: JBank announced an International Version for unsold long-term staked assets. The notice described release beginning after six months without user action or accelerated release through performance-based unlocking, and stated that no static returns would be generated during the waiting or unlocking period.
notes: This event records an issuer-described change in access and return mechanics, not proof that all affected assets were subsequently released or that any advertised prior return was realized.
